name: Majodou ~Ano Chirigiwa no Utsukushisa~
original_name: 魔女道～あの散り際の美しさ～
source:
A story taking place in an alternate world where witches co-exists with ordinary people. But according to their code, they must compete with each other and must not love anyone… Although competition meant a real war in the old days, it has now become a civilized sports tournament?!

[From [url=http://www.akiba-ch.com/?p=511]Akihabara Channel[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在魔女与普通人共存的平行世界。根据魔女的准则，她们必须彼此竞争，而且不得爱上任何人……过去的竞争意味着真正的战争，如今却已经变成文明的体育竞赛？！

[摘自[url=http://www.akiba-ch.com/?p=511]Akihabara Channel[/url]]
